market_pulse.note: About $71,842, down about 3.5% over 24 hours (CoinDesk), after touching a low near $71,635 (Coinpedia).
About $2,012, down about 3.7% over 24 hours, after briefly slipping below $2,000 (CoinDesk; Coinpedia).
Nearly $2.48 trillion, down more than $560 billion from about $3.04 trillion on Sept. 22 (Coinpedia).
About 58% to 60%: 59.9% early Thursday by TokenPost's measure and 58.4% on CoinGecko.

themes.title: Crypto slides with Nvidia shock
themes.summary: Bitcoin fell below $72,000 as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation rattled AI and tech stocks (CoinDesk; Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: Strategy to be removed from MSCI indexes
themes.summary: MSCI said Strategy (MSTR) will be removed from its global equity indexes after the close on Nov. 30, which could prompt selling by index funds; the stock fell about 6% to 7% (CoinDesk; Reuters via Kitco).

themes.title: Rising yields weigh on risk assets
themes.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield moved above 5% and markets put about a 94% chance on a quarter-point Fed hike Dec. 9 (CoinDesk).

themes.title: ETF outflows continue
themes.summary: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $300 million on Wednesday, nearly $270 million of it from BlackRock's IBIT, and ether ETFs lost about $145 million (CoinDesk, citing SoSoValue).

themes.title: Leveraged positions flushed
themes.summary: About $750 million in crypto positions were liquidated over 24 hours as prices fell (Coinpedia).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin and Ether both fell about 3.5% to 3.7% over 24 hours; Ether is down about 24% this quarter versus about 12% for Bitcoin (CoinDesk).

categories.name: Large-cap altcoins
categories.note: XRP fell about 4% and Solana about 4.5% over 24 hours (CoinDesk); XRP is down about 22% this week (Coinpedia).

categories.name: Memecoins
categories.note: Pepe was among the weakest coins again, down about 15.8% over 24 hours (CoinGecko).

categories.name: Crypto-linked stocks
categories.note: Strategy fell on the MSCI decision, and bitcoin miners and AI hosts IREN, Applied Digital and Core Scientific fell 3% to 5% (Reuters via Kitco).

watch_list.why: Another inflation reading ahead of the Fed's Dec. 9 meeting, where a rate hike is widely expected (CoinDesk; Reuters via Kitco).
Bitcoin is trading just above $71,000, with $70,000 being watched as the next support area (CoinDesk; crypto.news).

watch_list.topic: Strategy index exit and Nvidia results
watch_list.why: Strategy's MSCI removal takes effect after the Nov. 30 close, and Nvidia reports results Nov. 17, both of which could affect sentiment (CoinDesk).

movers.name: Ozone Chain (OZO)
movers.note: Top 24-hour gainer among the top 1,000 coins (CoinGecko).

movers.name: Initia (INIT)
movers.note: Largest 24-hour decliner among the top 1,000 coins (CoinGecko).
